_meta.description: Headline facts about Mumbai Metro Line 12 (Kalyan to Taloja). Each fact carries its own source and status.

status_values.verified: Confirmed by a primary source (MMRDA website or the MMRDA-published DPR).
status_values.reported: From a reputable secondary source (news or trade press). Not confirmed by a primary source.
status_values.unverified: Single weak source, or could not be confirmed. Show with a warning in the UI.
status_values.conflicting: Sources disagree. The value is the most recent credible figure; see 'alternatives'.

route.value: Kalyan to Amandoot (Taloja), via Dombivli MIDC, Kalyan Growth Centre, Wadavli, Turbhe and Pisarve

history.context: Final DPR, April 2019 (APMC Kalyan to Taloja, 17 stations)
Civil contract CA-240 scope (viaduct chainage -860.224 m to +21,316.022 m, 19 stations)

length_km.notes: Other outlets quote 23.756 km (Free Press Journal, Dec 2024). The UI should show 23.57 km (MMRDA) and explain that the length grew after the DPR when Kalyan and APMC Kalyan stations moved into Line 12 scope. MMRDA's approved alignment (20 Mar 2025) has a 22.166 km centre line plus a 1.229 km depot connection. MMRDA's loan invitation (March 2026) repeats the 2019 DPR figures, 20.756 km plus a 0.5 km depot connection with 17 stations; the project page and the CA-240 contract say 19 stations.

completion_cost_crore_inr.label: Estimated project cost, excluding interest during construction

alternatives.context: MMRDA's Line 12 project page: project completion cost, the 2019 DPR figure (land, taxes and interest during construction, escalated to March 2026)

completion_cost_crore_inr.notes: MMRDA's loan invitation (EOI, March 2026) gives an estimated project cost of Rs 11,516 crore plus IDC for Line 12. MMRDA's project page still gives Rs 5,865 crore. The DPR (April 2019) gives Rs 4,738 crore at March 2018 prices (with taxes, duties and land) and Rs 5,865 crore as completion cost including land and IDC, escalated at 5% a year to March 2026. The DPR's own year-wise table totals Rs 5,459 crore, so the DPR is internally inconsistent. Some trade press quotes Rs 4,132 crore and Rs 5,494 crore; no primary source was found for those figures.

funding.value: MMRDA is seeking a Rs 7,800 crore loan
funding.notes: In March 2026 MMRDA invited banks and financial institutions to lend Rs 7,800 crore for Line 12 (with Rs 6,300 crore for Line 10, Rs 14,100 crore together). Revenue sources it names: fare and non-fare revenue, and Urban Transport Fund support from the Government of Maharashtra. No lender had been announced as of the last check. Earlier: The DPR (April 2019) recommends that the project be built fully as a Government initiative, and says the Maharashtra Government will give the Rs 368 crore of land free of cost. It also models an SPV pattern with GoI equity Rs 837 crore, GoM equity Rs 837 crore and a multilateral loan of Rs 3,005 crore, but that is an option, not a decision. Wikipedia says AIIB and the OPEC Fund lent Rs 2,357.25 crore to the Orange Line, but no AIIB or MMRDA document ties that loan to Line 12. Do not show a funding split in the UI until a primary source is found.

history.value: Near Pisarve Depot station, 20 ha of private agricultural land

interchanges.notes: MMRDA spells it 'Vikroli-Badlapur'. Rail Analysis (Dec 2025) also reports a foot overbridge link to Central Railway at Kalyan Junction (status: reported).

daily_ridership_2031.notes: Matches the DPR projection of 2,62,320 for 2031 with property development.

travel_time_benefit.value: Reduces current travel time by 50% to 75%, depending on road conditions
travel_time_benefit.notes: MMRDA's loan invitation (March 2026) says the line saves about 45 minutes between Kalyan and Taloja.

current_phase.value: Civil construction (viaduct and stations). Systems and rolling stock tender stage.
current_phase.notes: Civil progress is verified (see 'progress'). The systems tender stage is from trade press, June 2026.

stages.notes: Each section of the line from planning to opening. 'sections' has one entry per part of the line that is built on its own (label null when the line is built as one). state: done, now (the current stage), started, next (not started). A note may contain {progress_as_of} or {event:<timeline id>}, which the page fills with that date, so the note stays current when the data changes. The facts behind each note are in timeline.json and in this file.

progress.summary: MMRDA publishes one progress table for the whole corridor, updated monthly. It does not publish progress by station.
progress.notes: MMRDA updates this table monthly. The Phase 5 feed job could re-check it.

overall_reported.notes: Loksatta (Marathi, 27 Sep 2026) quotes unnamed MMRDA sources: 53.87 per cent of the whole line is complete. MMRDA's own table gives no overall figure and the method behind this one is not stated, so it is not comparable with the activity figures.

alternatives.context: MMRDA statement reported by Free Press Journal, Dec 2024
Original DPR assumption (construction 1 Nov 2019 to 31 Oct 2024, opening 1 Nov 2024). Superseded.

target_completion.notes: The MMRDA project page gives no target date. May 2028 is the most recent reported target (Dec 2025). The countdown uses the last day of that month and the UI must label it 'reported target, not an official date'.

technical.signalling: CBTC-based continuous automatic train control (ATP, ATO, ATS)
technical.viaduct: Precast twin U-girders on single piers, bored cast-in-situ pile foundations; I-girders on sharp curves and at points and crossings
technical.notes: Design values from the April 2019 DPR. The systems contract (not yet awarded) may change them.
